refusals.why: The written reason must speak to each figure the evidence does not back: shelfChance 2/0, shelfChance 1/1, shortFigure SLOT bookAtZero.
The version has no kept trial: try it over at least 14 whole days first.
This version holds a what-if on planner data: it is a trial set and can never be the candidate set.
A carrier mode is on while a contract row it would use is assumed: CARRIER_SAME_DAY, CARRIER_NEXT_DAY.
Its newest trial T-0019 ended on 2026-10-14, more than 7 days before the marking.
